items.source: Called after a session's tool index has been cleared — either because this strategy returned it from ToolIndexEvictionStrategy.onAccess(String), or because of an explicit eviction request.
items.translation: 在会话的工具索引被清除后调用——无论是因为该策略通过ToolIndexEvictionStrategy.onAccess(String)返回了它，还是因为显式的驱逐请求。

items.source: Called each time a session is accessed at the start of request processing.
items.translation: 每次在请求处理开始时访问会话时都会调用。

items.source: Memory warning: this strategy accumulates one index entry per distinct session ID and never frees them. In a service that handles many short-lived conversations (e.g. HTTP sessions, anonymous users) the index map will grow without bound, eventually exhausting heap (Lucene ByteBuffersDirectory instances) or remote vector-store quota. For production deployments use LruEvictionStrategy to cap the number of concurrently retained indexes, TtlEvictionStrategy to expire idle sessions, or a CompositeEvictionStrategy combining both.
items.translation: 内存警告： 此策略会为每个不同的会话 ID 累积一个索引条目，且从不释放它们。在处理大量短生命周期对话的服务中（例如 HTTP 会话、匿名用户），索引映射将无限制增长，最终耗尽堆内存（Lucene ByteBuffersDirectory 实例）或远程向量存储配额。在生产部署中，请使用 LruEvictionStrategy 限制同时保留的索引数量，使用 TtlEvictionStrategy 使空闲会话过期，或使用结合两者的 CompositeEvictionStrategy。

items.source: Tool indexes persist across requests for the lifetime of the ToolSearchToolCallingAdvisor bean, or until explicitly released via ToolSearchToolCallingAdvisor#evictSession(String).
items.translation: 工具索引在 ToolSearchToolCallingAdvisor Bean 的生命周期内跨请求持久存在，或者直到通过 ToolSearchToolCallingAdvisor#evictSession(String) 显式释放为止。

items.source: Implementations should update their internal tracking state for sessionId and return the set of session IDs whose tool indexes must now be cleared. The returned set must never include the currently-accessed sessionId.
items.translation: 实现应更新其内部跟踪状态以处理sessionId，并返回必须清除工具索引的会话 ID 集合。该返回集合绝不能包含当前正在访问的sessionId。

items.source: This strategy is appropriate only when the set of active sessions is small and stable (e.g. a single-user tool or a bounded pool of long-running agents), or when the application manages session lifecycle explicitly via ToolSearchToolCallingAdvisor#evictSession(String).
items.translation: 该策略仅适用于活动会话集较小且稳定的情况（例如单用户工具或有限数量的长运行代理池），或者应用程序通过显式管理会话生命周期来使用`ToolSearchToolCallingAdvisor#evictSession(String)`方法时。

items.source: Implementations should remove any internal tracking state for the evicted session.
items.translation: 实现应移除被驱逐会话的任何内部跟踪状态。

items.source: session IDs to evict; never null, may be empty
items.translation: 待驱逐的会话 ID；永远不会为null，可能为空。

items.source: A ToolIndexEvictionStrategy that never evicts sessions automatically.
items.translation: 一个永远不会自动驱逐会话的ToolIndexEvictionStrategy。
